design_philosophy.description: A finance dashboard that breaks the 'boring blue tech' stereotype. Uses warm, tactile colors and a grounded earthy palette to make dense Tally data feel approachable and reliable. Negative space is highly prioritized to avoid visual fatigue.

spacing_and_layout.alignment_rules: Left-align dense tabular data and inputs. Right-align numerical data in tables. Center-align empty state illustrations only.

cards.style: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-stone-200), rounded-xl, no heavy shadows.

buttons.primary: bg-[#064E3B] text-white hover:bg-[#047857] shadow-sm rounded-lg px-6 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-stone-200 text-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-50 shadow-[0_2px_4px_rgba(28,25,23,0.05)] rounded-lg px-6 py-2 transition-all

tables.header: Sticky top, bg-stone-50, text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-500 font-semibold py-4 border-b border-stone-200
tables.zebra_striping: Even rows bg-white, odd rows bg-[#FDFBF7]

ai_query_builder.container: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 p-8 shadow-sm
ai_query_builder.background_overlay: absolute inset-0 opacity-10 bg-cover bg-center mix-blend-multiply
ai_query_builder.input_area: relative z-10 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl p-2 border border-stone-200/50 shadow-inner flex items-center gap-4

navigation_header.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-stone-200 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between

logo.description: Minimalist textured logo to be used as a brand placeholder in the navbar.

user_avatar.description: Professional confident business woman portrait for user profile avatars.

ai_feature_bg.description: Abstract 3D topography map in earthy tones to be used as a subtle background for the AI Report Builder section to make it feel premium and intelligent.

login_bg.description: Soft blurred gradient background in warm sand and moss green. Use for login/authentication pages.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure all text against the #FDFBF7 or #FFFFFF backgrounds passes at least 4.5:1 ratio (e.g. use #1C1917 or #064E3B).
accessibility.test_attributes: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements. Example: data-testid='ai-generate-btn'.
